articleTitle: Space processor radiation mitigation and validation techniques for an 1,800 MIPS processor board
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 7th European Conference on Radiation and Its Effects on Components and Systems, 2003. RADECS 2003.
abstract: The latest commercial computing performance has been unavailable to the space community because of radiation reliability issues and the time and resources required to bring a radiation hardened version to market. This paper discusses computing performance, radiation mitigation, characterization and testing of a single board computer for space based on the latest IBM 750FX SO1 processor. The architecture, design, error mitigation techniques and radiation testing and evaluation of the design's performance are presented.

articleTitle: Comparison of xilinx virtex-II FPGA SEE sensitivities to protons and heavy ions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 7th European Conference on Radiation and Its Effects on Components and Systems, 2003. RADECS 2003.
abstract: A comparison of heavy-ion and proton-induced single event effect sensitivities has been made using the Xilinx Virtex-11 field programmable gate array (FPGA). Recently fabricated test samples are selected for observations of single event upset and single event functional interrupt. A complex relationship appears to exist between the heavy ion and proton sensitivities due to effects such as multiplrbit upsets and elastic nuclear scattering.
